procurement_key_commitments: EU Frankfurt data residency guaranteed in writing (DPA exhibit)
99.9% uptime SLA with credits >= 10% monthly fee per breach
Annual price cap: max 5% uplift on renewal
30-day subprocessor change notice clause (already standard with Zoho)
Data export in standard CSV/JSON within 30 days of termination
procurement_negotiation_leverage: 40-seat deal is mid-tier but 2-year commit gives vendor revenue certainty — use for discount
Peak-season deadline (October go-live) creates urgency; vendor keen to close before Q3 end
Competitor bids from HubSpot and Salesforce provide active BATNA to press for 10-15% discount
Zoho's low switching cost acknowledged internally; vendor aware retention incentive is high
Bundle Zoho CRM + Zoho One add-ons as future upsell — offer roadmap commitment in exchange for price lock

procurement_risks.risk: Contract auto-renews on unfavourable terms if review window missed
procurement_risks.mitigation: Set calendar alert 90 days before contract anniversary; assign contract owner

procurement_risks.risk: Price uplift at year-2 renewal erodes 3-year savings case
procurement_risks.mitigation: Negotiate max 5% annual uplift cap in initial contract; accept 2-year term in exchange

procurement_risks.risk: Vendor changes subprocessors affecting GDPR compliance without adequate notice
procurement_risks.mitigation: Enforce 30-day notice clause; DPA must list current subprocessors as exhibit

procurement_risks.risk: Export clause not exercised in time post-termination leading to data lock-in
procurement_risks.mitigation: Contract specifies 30-day export window and machine-readable format; test export in UAT

procurement_risks.risk: NetSuite connector (third-party) not covered by Zoho SLA
procurement_risks.mitigation: Obtain SLA from connector vendor separately; include in integration risk register
